scientific_claim: Under the frozen integrated maintenance matrix, an error-only monitor identified the unknown damaged Wingless higher-level structure in all twelve sequential degradation cycles without lesion labels. A same-budget wrong repair candidate produced zero held-out gain and was reverted in every cycle; the correct retained candidate produced a 0.4375 held-out gain and was retained in every cycle. Each cycle restored perfect affected, unaffected, and level-1 prediction plus exact canonical structure identity with zero unlesioned mutation and no capacity growth.
program_interpretation: This closes the previously open primitive loop in the tested synthetic regime: native prediction -> internal error observation -> bounded target selection -> candidate intervention -> independent held-out validation -> revert wrong candidate -> retain correct candidate -> continue from retained state -> repeat on a second unseen degradation. It does not establish open-domain autonomous self-maintenance or frontier-LLM competence.
next_question: Test whether the same closed-loop policy generalizes across heterogeneous unseen degradation classes and under distribution shift, rather than only repeated loss of one known higher-level structure class.
scope: bounded synthetic integrated raw-byte cognitive maintenance; no open-domain language claim
